ns2:course.label: Mathematical Logic
ns2:course.description: Development of first order predicate logic; completeness theorem; formalized number theory and the Godel incompleteness theorem. Prerequisite: MATH 417 or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: MATH 417 or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Graduate - Urbana-Champaign. Not intended for MS:Economics:Policy Econ -UIUC or MS: Financial Engineering.
